title: Ollama: A Robot On YOUR Computer
goal: A LOCAL robot lives in your computer. No WiFi. Just slower.
mascot_lines: Ollama is special because it lives right on your own computer.
It doesn't need the internet, so it works even when the wifi is off.
And whatever you type stays on your machine — nobody else sees it.
It can be a little slower, but it's all yours.

tier2.rephrase: Ollama lives WHERE? On your computer or online?

tier3.nudge: Local means HOME. Ollama's home is your computer!

sandbox.hint: Type 'hi' and see what your local helper says!
